subject: Mutual Action Plan draft — Novus Health go-live timeline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@novushealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (attached)

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps; attaching the first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx) for your review. [attachment: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx]

Summary of what we discussed (short):
- Objective: embed Redwood inference for personalized clinical note generation in Novus Careflow by Q4.
- Key constraints: SOC2 evidence required, SAML SSO integration for staff access, procurement timeline tied to Q4 budget cycle.

Draft MAP (high-level milestones):
1) Legal & Procurement review — responsibility: Novus (Jordan Mills) / Redwood legal — target complete: 2026-08-28
2) Security questionnaire & evidence exchange — responsibility: Novus security / Redwood compliance — target complete: 2026-08-21
3) Integration sprint (API + SSO) — responsibility: Novus eng / Redwood SRE (Rishi) — target complete: 2026-09-18
4) Acceptance test (3 pilot clinics) — responsibility: Novus success (Marissa) / Novus product — target complete: 2026-10-02
5) Go-live & monitoring handoff — responsibility: Joint — target go-live: 2026-10-09

Dependencies and risks:
- Procurement signatures (authority confirmation) — blocks contract start.
- Final SOC2 artifacts may require additional time if gaps are flagged.
- SAML integration timeline depends on Novus infra availability (we flagged two-week window for test accounts).

Please review the MAP and mark any changes directly in the spreadsheet or reply with comments. If this looks good, we can lock milestones and request DocuSign from legal.

Next immediate asks:
- Elena / Jordan: confirm procurement decision authority and target date for signature.
- Novus security: confirm if the attached security questionnaire covers what you need, or flag additional evidence items.

Thanks — I’ll follow up after I get your feedback and can adjust dates as needed.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@novushealth.com>

Date: 2026-08-11T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (attached)

Thanks Stephanie — useful summary and thanks for pulling the MAP together. A few quick notes from Novus side: 

1) Procurement: Jordan (cc’d) is our procurement lead and needs an estimate of monthly token cost and a copy of standard SLA language. Can you have those ready by 8/25?
2) Security: the MAP looks good but Novus security will need the SOC2 report and an inventory of data flows (we capture PHI in notes). Can Redwood confirm whether PHI will be routed through your hosted environment or if the Dedicated option is required?
3) Dates: the 10/09 go-live is aggressive for us unless legal/procurement sign by 8/28. If procurement delays, we will need a backup plan for a pilot-only go-live in late September.

I’ll review the spreadsheet and mark the procurement owner field. Attaching Novus internal procurement checklist for your reference. [attachment: novus_procurement_checklist.pdf]

On the security point — please have Rishi or compliance reach out to our InfoSec (cc’d) with the questionnaire result.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
VP Product Operations | Novus Health
elena.ortiz@novushealth.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@novushealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (attached)

Elena — quick technical clarifications and a mitigation suggestion.

- PHI handling: Redwood supports both hosted and Dedicated deployments. For hosted, PHI can be accepted under a BAA and configured to minimize log retention; Dedicated provides customer-isolated runtime and is recommended if Novus requires no co-mingling of inference traffic.
- Identity: SAML SSO is preferred; if Novus needs faster onboarding we can provision API-key-based test accounts for pilot clinics while SAML is implemented. That reduces pilot friction.

I’ve filled out the security questionnaire and attached the completed form and a short evidence index (SOC2 summary + network diagram) to help expedite InfoSec review. [attachment: novus_security_questionnaire_filled.pdf]

Proposed tweak to MAP to reduce risk: move 'Integration sprint' target earlier by one week and add a 2-week contingency for SAML. That gives procurement time while preserving the September pilot window. I’ll update the spreadsheet if we have agreement.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@novushealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (attached)

Elena / team — quick customer-success take:

- Acceptance criteria we will use for the pilot (so legal/procurement know scope):
  * 95% availability during pilot window for inference endpoints used by pilot clinics
  * Generation latency median < 500ms for standard note template under pilot load
  * False-positive rate for PHI redaction (if enabled) below 2% as measured on our test prompt set

If Novus signs procurement by 8/28, our success team can support three clinics in a staged rollout the week of 9/20 for acceptance testing. If procurement slips, we can still run a single-clinic pilot early September using API-key test accounts (per Rishi).

I’ll add these acceptance criteria to the MAP and highlight them in the shared doc.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
